description: Hybrid cage: KDPG trimer (605 residues) attached to a DNA cage (393 nucleotides) by mutual traps, from examples/DNANM/hybrid_cage. ANMT parameters added with tools/add_anmt_angles.py.

xfail.*@CUDA: DNACT is not implemented on CUDA yet
xfail.det: the original code adds the nucleotide's excluded-volume torque to the protein particle (protein->torque -= protein->orientationT * -torquenuc); the current code adds (r x F) about the protein centre, which is zero for this central force, so ANMT trajectories diverge as soon as a protein-nucleotide contact occurs
